section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a single study sample of 1012 adolescents and young adults (482 boys, 530 girls) from Denmark (n = 129), Portugal (n = 513), and Sweden (n = 370). Participants were aged 12–19 (overall M = 15.1, SD = 1.9; country means reported) and self-reported BMI (range 11.72–51.14; overall M = 21.01; country means reported). The section does not report survey method, participant ethnicity, recruitment/source, assessment of body appreciation (BAS/BAS-2), or correlations between body appreciation and BMI.
section_summary.evidence_source: The total sample consisted of 1012 adolescents and young adults (482 boys and 530 girls)from Denmark (n = 129), Portugal(n = 513), and Sweden (n = 370). They were aged from 12 to 19 years old (M = 15.1, SD = 1.9 for the total sample; M = 14.4, SD = 2.1 for the Danish sample; M = 15.0, SD = 2.1 for the Portuguese sample; and M = 15.5, SD = 1.3 for the Swedish sample). The self-reported BMI level of participants ranged from 11.72 to 51.14 kg/m2 (M = 21.01, SD = 3.57 for the total sample; M = 19.61, SD = 3.85 for the Danish sample; M = 20.89, SD = 3.41 for the Portuguese sample; and M = 21.68, SD = 3.54 for the Swedish sample).
